description: This file defines a React component named SearchPanel which provides UI for searching nearby attractions based on a center point, as well as searching places via Nominatim geocoding service. It interacts with external services 'nominatim' and 'opentripmap' to fetch data, and communicates results back via callback props.

methods.name: SearchPanel({ center, onResults, onAdd })
methods.description: React functional component providing UI for searching attractions and places.

methods.name: searchNearby
methods.description: Fetches nearby attractions based on the provided center coordinates using 'fetchAttractionsByRadius'.

methods.name: searchPlaces
methods.description: Performs a geocode search of the input term using 'geocodeSearch' and formats the results.

ctags.name: SearchPanel
ctags.pattern: /^export default function SearchPanel({ center, onResults, onAdd }) {$/
